_about: The token tree build_tokens.py turns into tokens.json. apollographql.com's Next.js/Tailwind build declares a real token layer (raw/css-vars.json): the --color-* palette, --font-* stacks, --radius-* and --duration-* scales, resolved live by tools/capture/vars.mjs. Leaves name that variable ("var") where one exists and carry a measured "value" + "source" where the var is only the start (the dark-page CTA fill is a measured #e75e15 brand-accent, the conic-gradient hero border has no var). Two themes are painted: the marketing pages are dark navy/#02060a surfaces with offwhite text; the blog and the top of contact-sales are light. The stylesheet's [data-theme="dark"] block re-binds the same semantic names for dark sections.
